primary.title: Sectoral mutual funds: Should you invest? Risks, returns and 5 things to consider before investing your money
primary.summary: Sectoral mutual funds can deliver higher returns but carry concentration, valuation and timing risks. Experts explain five factors investors should consider, including risk appetite, sector performance, earnings growth, entry timing and portfolio allocation.
